name: What factors influence the cost of trim replacement?

mainEntity.name: What factors influence the cost of trim replacement?

acceptedAnswer.text: Total project cost depends on linear footage, the chosen material, profile complexity, and whether painting and wall prep are included. Simple MDF baseboard replacement costs significantly less than custom, multi-piece hardwood crown molding. Additional labor factors include removing existing trim without tearing drywall paper, leveling uneven walls or floors, and performing full finish work such as caulking, filling nail holes, and painting. Combining trim work with larger remodeling or drywall repairs often reduces total mobilization costs.
acceptedAnswer.description: Costs depend on total linear footage, material choice (wood vs. MDF), profile complexity, wall prep, drywall patching, and whether caulking and painting are included.
